body.name: ComponentHandle
body.construction: For the fixed known \(x_0\), construct \(\mathfrak H_{n,x_0}^{\mathrm{comp}}\) by multiplying a smooth squared partition of unity at fine scale \(\ell\) by a translated compact \(C^\infty\) localization bump that equals one at \(x_0\), using shared Rademacher coefficients and joint \((A,Y)\)-cell perturbations that cancel after one sign average.  Conditional on \(X_{1:n}\), connect observations whose active frames share a coefficient, factor the mixture over connected components, control each non-singleton component through a mixed amplitude derivative, and sum connected subsets by labeled spanning trees.  The localization is restricted to \([0,1]^d\); at a boundary point this only reduces its active volume and never changes the exact uniform design.
